label: Quick note
description: Saves the text as a new note or appends it to one, in your notes folder
pathToNotesInfo: Use an absolute path or ~/notes. For Logseq, choose the graph root; journals is added automatically.
saveModeCreate: Create a new file for each note
saveModeAppend: Append to a file (create if missing)
customSubfolderTemplateInfo: Supports date tokens only: {'{'}YYYY{'}'}, {'{'}YY{'}'}, {'{'}MM{'}'}, {'{'}DD{'}'}, {'{'}HH{'}'}, {'{'}mm{'}'}, {'{'}ss{'}'}, {'{'}WW{'}'}, {'{'}GGGG{'}'}, {'{'}zettel{'}'}, {'{'}timestamp{'}'} (GGGG is the ISO week year; zettel includes milliseconds). Folder separator is /.
fileNameTemplateInfo: Supports date tokens ({'{'}YYYY{'}'}, {'{'}YY{'}'}, {'{'}MM{'}'}, {'{'}DD{'}'}, {'{'}HH{'}'}, {'{'}mm{'}'}, {'{'}ss{'}'}, {'{'}WW{'}'}, {'{'}GGGG{'}'}, {'{'}zettel{'}'}, {'{'}timestamp{'}'}), as well as {'{'}title{'}'} and {'{'}slug{'}'}. Files receive a numeric suffix on name collisions.
contentTemplateInfo: Supports date tokens, {'{'}title{'}'}, and required {'{'}content{'}'}. Write {'{'}{'{'} or {'}'}{'}'} for a literal brace. When a heading uses {'{'}title{'}'}, the first line is not repeated below it. Append mode creates the file if missing.
toolDescription: Saves the text as a new note or appends it to one, in your notes folder
noNotesPath: Notes folder is not configured in the Quick note plugin settings
invalidNotesPath: Use an absolute notes path or a path starting with ~/.
invalidSubfolder: Subfolder must be relative, use / as the separator, and contain no .., reserved names such as CON, or invalid path characters.
unknownTemplateToken: Unknown template token {'{'}{token}{'}'}. Check the supported tokens, or write {'{'}{'{'} and {'}'}{'}'} for literal braces.
invalidFileName: File name template contains control characters.
noteSaveDenied: Writing to the notes folder is not allowed. Check its permissions and that the folder is saved in the settings.
noteSaveInvalid: The notes folder or file name is not valid. Check the folder or shorten the file name template.
noteTooLarge: The note is too large, or the disk is full.
